description.en: Changes the field position of a match member already added with CMND_BTL_ADD_MEMBER, looked up by team slot and character ID or number.
Index of the team/side the member belongs to.
Character ID string, or a numeric character index, identifying the member to move.
New field position slot to assign.

True once the call has been processed (the position is only actually updated if the member is found on that team slot; otherwise this is a silent no-op); null if fewer than 2 arguments were given or the call was otherwise invalid.
